subject.title: [Bug]: All channels enter broken state after 2026.6.11 update — one message per session then permanent silence

question: Should this issue remain the broad v2026.6.11 all-channel incident tracker until open PRs https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/101920 and https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/99365 plus stable-package proof are resolved, or should maintainers split it under narrower trackers now?
rationale: The report overlaps a stable package-parity bug, a current-source reply-init self-heal gap, and a WhatsApp durable replay storm; choosing the canonical tracking and stable-release closure criteria requires maintainer incident/release judgment.

options.title: Keep Broad Tracker
options.body: Keep this issue open as the incident umbrella until the open candidate PRs and stable package proof cover the full WebChat plus WhatsApp symptom set.

options.title: Split Into Narrow Trackers
options.body: Move the remaining pieces to the reply-session conflict, WhatsApp replay, and stable release trackers, then close this only after each has a clear owner and proof target.

options.title: Close Under One Root Cause
options.body: Close this as a duplicate only if maintainers decide a single canonical item fully explains both the all-channel silence and duplicate-reply behavior.

recommendation.title: Keep Broad Tracker
recommendation.body: Keep this issue open as the incident umbrella until the open candidate PRs and stable package proof cover the full WebChat plus WhatsApp symptom set.

likelyOwner.reason: The unresolved choice is tied to stable package inclusion and beta-versus-stable proof, where this person already verified the related beta package fix.
